trust_decision.summary: Whether a translation key (msgid, split on keyseparator) may be used as a property name when building nested i18next objects; decided nowhere at the pinned commit, added in js2i18next's key loop.

landing_point.why: Summary names js2i18next() and crafted keys; the only dynamic nested write in that file is appendTo[keys[x]] = appendTo[keys[x]] || {} in the separator-split loop.

fix_sites.entry_point: none directly; UNSAFE_KEYS constant imported by js2i18next (fix.diff:141)
browser bundle global `gettext.js2i18next` / `gettext.po2i18next` (generated by browserify, fix.diff:17-80)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only extra site is the regenerated browser bundle gettext.js (fix.diff:17-80) and gettext.min.js (fix.diff:83), produced by `npm run browser` (package.json:102), not an independent implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: poParser route: 'the advisory is about js2i18next key nesting; po2js is a parser that just builds the gettext table, a different function and a different direction of conversion'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate nested keys via the '##' (or custom keyseparator) split must still nest (e.g. 'a##b' -> {a:{b:..}}), keys merely containing 'proto'/'constructor' as substrings, context suffixing with ctxSeparator, and keyasareference remapping must keep working; dropping all separator keys or substring-matching breaks fixtures.

O6_input_shapes: '__proto__' as an intermediate segment of a separator-split key ('__proto__##x')
unsafe segment after a safe one ('a##constructor##x')
bare unsafe key with no separator ('__proto__')
custom options.keyseparator (check uses the same `separator` variable)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PO msgctxt '__proto__' makes normalize() write tokens into Object.prototype via translations[msgctxt][msgid], before js2i18next ever runs in po2i18next.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the PO parser behind po2js, not js2i18next; the key is the context, not the msgid the report talks about.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file from landing point (lib/poParser.js, reached via lib/po2js.js:4 and lib/po2i18next.js:5)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: With a non-default ctxSeparator, flatten() can derive context '__proto__' from an i18next key, and parseGettext writes trans[context][key] onto Object.prototype.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Opposite conversion direction (i18next2js/i18next2po) and only with a non-default ctxSeparator option; default '_' cannot yield a context containing '_'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: keyasareference remap writes data[ctx][id] from comments.reference ids; a variant that nests reference ids by separator directly would bypass the main-loop check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The reference-remap block already does its own dynamic writes before the guarded loop; a maintainer adding nested-reference support would naturally split there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an unflatten/merge helper for options.base that rebuilds nested objects from '##'-joined keys.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: i18next2js already merges options.base (lib/i18next2js.js:164-175); a nested merge is a plausible feature next to it.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via dynamic property names from translation keys

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm; babel, browserify, uglify-js, mocha, eslint (package.json:80-104)
O10_build.project_tests: test/test.js runs each converter through '../' and '../cjs/<name>' (test/test.js:3-8); js2i18next and po2i18next fixture tests at test/test.js:20-29; tests need `npm run build` first (package.json:103-104).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '__proto__' segments in the js2i18next split loop only, leaving 'constructor##prototype' chains and the poParser msgctxt write open.

out_of_scope_notes: lib/i18next2js.js:119-121 with keyasareference: a translation value '__proto__' makes trans[ctx][value] resolve to Object.prototype and then crash on .comments (crash, not pollution).
unverified: Repo size not measured; lib/ is ~14 small files plus a browser bundle, so far under 5 MB (tiny_repo assumed).

Scope judgement: the poParser msgctxt route is a different write site (the parser's table builder) from the published sink; I counted it as O8 because po2i18next feeds it the same crafted PO input and the advisory property is the same Object.prototype pollution from translation keys.
lib/js2i18next.js:66 with reference id '__proto__' resets the prototype of the local data[ctx] object only; judged not global pollution, not run.
Whether hidden tests should also require the regenerated gettext.js bundle is unknown; it is only rebuilt via `npm run browser`.
